content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"a team member reviewing the task report","i_want":"to filter, search and sort the tasks in the task report","so_that":"I can find specific tasks by status, priority, date range or title","business_description":"The task report shows all tasks in a table. Users can narrow the list by Status, Priority and Date Range, search by task title, and sort by Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority. The backend provides the APIs that support filtering, searching, sorting and metric aggregation for the report.","business_value":"Users can locate the tasks they need in the report without scanning every row.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task report containing tasks with different statuses","when":"the user selects one Status value in the Status filter","then":"only tasks with that Status are listed in the table"},{"given":"a task report containing tasks with different priorities","when":"the user selects one Priority value in the Priority filter","then":"only tasks with that Priority are listed in the table"},{"given":"a task report containing tasks with dates inside and outside a chosen range","when":"the user sets a Date Range filter","then":"only tasks whose date falls inside the range are listed in the table"},{"given":"tasks titled 'Quarterly report' and 'Budget review' in the task report","when":"the user enters 'report' in the title search","then":"only the task titled 'Quarterly report' is listed in the table"},{"given":"a task report with several tasks listed","when":"the user sorts by Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority","then":"the table rows are ordered by the selected field"},{"given":"the reporting page is opened and tasks exist","when":"the page finishes loading","then":"every task is shown as one row in the table"},{"given":"the task report API receives a request with filter, search and sort parameters","when":"the request is processed","then":"the response contains only the tasks that match all supplied parameters, in the requested sort order"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state which date Date Range applies to (creation date, due date or both). To be confirmed before build.","The PRD does not state whether several filters combine with AND logic. To be confirmed.","The PRD does not state the title search rules (case sensitivity, partial or whole-word match). To be confirmed.","The PRD does not state the sort direction or the default sort order. To be confirmed.","The PRD does not define the ranking order of Status or Priority values when sorting. To be confirmed.","When no task matches the filters or search, the table has no rows. The PRD does not define an empty-state message.","If a task has no due date, the PRD does not state where it appears when sorting by Due Date.","The PRD does not state what happens when Date Range start is later than its end. To be confirmed."],"dependencies":["US-create-and-view-tasks","US-complete-and-reopen-task"],"definition_of_done":["Filter by Status, Priority and Date Range returns the expected rows in automated tests","Title search returns the expected rows in automated tests","Sorting by Creation Date, Due Date, Status and Priority is verified in automated tests","Task report API accepts filter, search and sort parameters and is documented","Reporting page table shows all tasks and is verified in a manual or automated check","Open questions from the edge cases list are answered and recorded in the story"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-report-query-api","title":"[BE] Add task report API with filter, search and sort parameters","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Expose the API that returns tasks for the report, applying Status, Priority and Date Range filters, title search and sort by Creation Date, Due Date, Status or Priority. Metric aggregation is part of the same API requirement and is covered by its own story.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-5f4ef76c","R-48e39a9d","R-f214002a","R-8007d6b5"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint accepts Status, Priority, Date Range, title search and sort parameters","Filters, search and sort are applied in the database query, not in the client","Invalid parameter values return a documented error response","Unit and integration tests cover each parameter and their combination","API contract is documented"]},{"key_slug":"report-filter-search-sort-controls","title":"[FE] Add filter, search and sort controls to the task report","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Add Status, Priority and Date Range filter controls, a title search box and sort controls to the reporting page.
